allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3100/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; Write-Output "home -> HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Output "home -> ERRO: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3100/cirurgia-robotica" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; Write-Output "cirurgia-robotica -> HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Output "cirurgia-robotica -> ERRO: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(foreach \($p in @\("/areas-de-atuacao","/prostata-aumentada","/vasectomia","/pedra-no-rim","/cancer-de-prostata"\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90; $html = $r.Content; $hdr = if \($html -match 'site-header'\) {'sim'} else {'NAO'}; $nav = \([regex]::Matches\($html, 'Áreas de Atuação'\)\).Count; $cards = \([regex]::Matches\($html, 'condicao-card"'\)\).Count; $lpheader = if \($html -match 'lp-header'\) {'AINDA TEM'} else {'ok'}; Write-Output "$p -> HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\) | Header site: $hdr | menu-refs: $nav | cards: $cards | lp-header removido: $lpheader" } catch { Write-Output "$p -> ERRO: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell(foreach \($p in @\("/prostata-aumentada","/vasectomia","/pedra-no-rim","/cancer-de-prostata"\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90; $html = $r.Content; $splits = \([regex]::Matches\($html, 'lp-split '\)\).Count; $slots = \([regex]::Matches\($html, 'lp-media-slot"'\)\).Count; $bands = \([regex]::Matches\($html, 'lp-band-card'\)\).Count; Write-Output "$p -> HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\) | splits: $splits | image-slots: $slots | bands: $bands" } catch { Write-Output "$p -> ERRO: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell(foreach \($p in @\("/areas-de-atuacao","/prostata-aumentada","/vasectomia","/pedra-no-rim","/cancer-de-prostata"\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90; $menuItem = if \($r.Content -match '#condicoes-em-destaque'\) {'AINDA NO MENU'} else {'removido do menu'}; $section = if \($r.Content -match 'id="condicoes-em-destaque"'\) {'secao presente'} else {'-'}; Write-Output "$p -> HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\) | $menuItem | $section" } catch { Write-Output "$p -> ERRO: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
